name: toggle_dark_mode
description: Turn macOS dark mode on or off
script: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to {{state == on}}
verifyScript: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to get dark mode

name: set_volume
script: tell application "System Events" to set (sound volume of (get volume settings)) to {{level}}
verifyScript: get output volume of (get volume settings)

name: add_reminder
script: tell application "Reminders" to tell list "Reminders" to make new reminder with properties {name:{{text}}}
utteranceExamples: add a reminder to call Sam

name: create_calendar_event
utteranceExamples: create a calendar event called standup at 10

name: start_timer
description: Start a timer and notify when it finishes
script:
set dueDate to (current date) + ({{minutes}} * minutes)
tell application "Reminders" to tell list "Reminders" to make new reminder with properties {name:"Timer finished", remind me date:dueDate}

name: empty_downloads
description: Move the contents of Downloads to the Trash
script: tell application "Finder" to delete every item of folder "Downloads" of home
